purpose: Read-only Canvas grade scan and teacher alert. This workflow MUST NOT modify grades, assignments, submissions, or student records. Parent communication is never sent automatically; only copy-ready templates are produced for the teacher.

recipient.scopeNote: quarter (default): missing work, low scores, and course averages come from the current quarter only. year: the full-year view, only when Owen asks for it (bin/grade-check --scope year).

scheduling.note: Local launchd LaunchAgent runs Mon-Fri 04:15 PM. launchd uses the Mac's local wall clock; this Mac is on America/New_York.

rotation.note: The rotating-subject rule applies ONLY to History vs Science. Math, Reading/Spelling, and Language Arts are core academic courses that remain active in every quarter. Homeroom (26429) is never grade-checked.

history.note: Assignment groups are manual-only; classify by verified test title keywords.

science.note: Assignment groups are manual-only; classify by verified test title keywords.

classification.note: Title keywords are applied only when the assignment group is not a canonical assessment or non-assessment group. Ambiguous classifications are reported as unresolved and never guessed.

missing.note: A submission is treated as missing when Canvas reports missing=true or the grade string matches a marker (case-insensitive).
missing.missingRequiresGradedNote: true (default): an assignment counts toward missing only when at least one student has an entered grade (any score, letter, or MI). An assignment with no entered grades is not graded yet and is skipped entirely: no flags, no names, only a count. EX/excused is never missing and does not count as an entered grade.

enrollment.note: A student who joined after an assignment's due date is NOT eligible for missing-assignment flagging, missing-work counts, or a low-course-average derived from pre-enrollment blanks. An assignment is ineligible for a student when its due date is before the student's effective enrollment eligibility date (Canvas enrollment start_at, else created_at).

localOverride.authority: local teacher-owned authority; overrides ambiguous Canvas enrollment metadata when explicitly configured
